lines: 1. Add a product and its data sheet. 2. Check it and tap Assess — the assessment is saved in a folder. 3. Add assessments to a job from its COSHH page (Add from COSHH Library), or tick them here to export or email.
+ Upload ready-made PDFs into the top level
📥 Make assessments from data sheets into the top level

Pick one Safety Data Sheet to check it first, or several at once: each becomes a product with its own COSHH assessment in this folder. On the office laptop the codes are read off each sheet for you — always check them.
